name: Lydia
source:
Guild master and Founder of the Feallmharfoir (aka The Fell Assassins). Lydia is a half-elf which means she is shunned by elves and humans. Considering her heritage, founding the Fell is an amazing and mysterious feat. Lydia has secrets involving the [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]MC[/url].
